# Warp Animation — attribution and license

- Work: Warp Animation
- Author / CodePen username: php-hacker
- Source: https://codepen.io/php-hacker/pen/dyVdgRX
- Retrieved: 2026-10-29
- License: MIT, under CodePen's public-Pen licensing policy: https://blog.codepen.io/docs/pens/licensing/
- Adapted file: `assets/warp.js` (repository root).

The fragment shader's coordinate-warp and color algorithm is adapted from the linked Pen. Changes: integer loop counters and explicit casts for WebGL compatibility; local resolution calculation; mediump precision for broader device support; bounded render resolution; 30fps animation; pause/resume control; reduced-motion support; visibility suspension; context-loss fallback and recovery; resize handling; error handling. The page layout, styling and experiment navigation are new. A CSS overlay darkens the background for readable text. No external scripts or media from the Pen are loaded.
